links.outcome: Fall incidents with AI patient sitter monitoring versus prior baseline
links.effect: 83.33% reduction in fall incidents; only one fall (3.3%) among 30 patients; 1,439 alerts with 95.34% accuracy; median alert response 21 seconds.
links.quote: The integration of this system led to an 83.33% reduction in fall incidents and the generation of 1,439 alerts with a 95.34% accuracy rate.

unlisted_practices: Use of privacy-preserving blurred, non-identifiable imaging in AI patient monitoring

screen.reason: Prospective real-world clinical deployment of an AI-powered optical motion-sensing system for fall detection/alerting in a stroke unit; evaluates system implementation and clinical outcomes rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice variation.
